title: Motherhood
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: Change is non-negotiable — but the way most of us try to make it happen doesn't work. We pile on willpower, self-help and resolutions, and wonder why none of it sticks. This week we sit with the lie underneath that, and look at the four-move pattern God gave Solomon for the real thing — humility, prayer, seeking, turning. Real growth isn't something you pull off. It's something Jesus does in you, daily, often by millimetres.

Culture tells moms that raising kids is a placeholder for their 'real life.' Scripture says the opposite. This Mother's Day, Pastor Antwan opens Genesis, Proverbs 31, and Isaiah to show what Jesus actually says about a mom's worth, her calling, and the help she's been promised when the weight gets too heavy.
quotes: Motherhood is not for the weak.
He's holding you so you can hold them.
The Bible doesn't ask Mom to pick. The Bible asks Mom to integrate.
